description: This file defines the FastMath class, which provides high-performance, accurate alternatives to standard Java Math functions for large-scale computations. It includes implementations for various mathematical operations such as exponential, logarithm, trigonometric functions, hyperbolic functions, and more, often utilizing lookup tables and polynomial approximations for efficiency.

classes.name: FastMath
classes.description: A utility class providing fast, accurate implementations of common mathematical functions for double and float types, intended to replace and extend Java's standard Math and StrictMath classes.

methods.name: sqrt
methods.description: Calculates the square root of a number by delegating to Math.sqrt.

methods.name: cosh
methods.description: Computes the hyperbolic cosine of a number using high-precision approximations and exponential functions.

methods.name: sinh
methods.description: Computes the hyperbolic sine of a number using high-precision approximations and exponential functions.

methods.name: tanh
methods.description: Calculates the hyperbolic tangent of a number via exponential functions.

methods.name: acosh
methods.description: Returns the inverse hyperbolic cosine of a number.

methods.name: asinh
methods.description: Returns the inverse hyperbolic sine of a number, utilizing different approximations depending on magnitude for accuracy.

methods.name: atanh
methods.description: Computes the inverse hyperbolic tangent of a number with different polynomial approximations based on magnitude.

methods.name: signum
methods.description: Determines the sign of a double or float number, returning -1, 0, or 1 accordingly.

methods.name: nextUp
methods.description: Returns the floating point number adjacent to a given number towards positive infinity.

methods.name: nextDown
methods.description: Returns the neighboring floating point number towards negative infinity.

methods.name: random
methods.description: Returns a pseudo-random number between 0.0 and 1.0 delegating to Math.random.

methods.name: exp
methods.description: Computes the exponential function e^x using a combination of table lookups and polynomial approximation.

methods.name: expm1
methods.description: Calculates e^x - 1 with high accuracy using internal helper methods for different input ranges.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Computes the natural logarithm of a number, including a high-precision implementation that handles special cases.

methods.name: log1p
methods.description: Calculates log(1 + x) accurately for small x.

methods.name: log10
methods.description: Computes the base-10 logarithm, utilizing the high-precision log implementation.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Computes the logarithm of a given number in an arbitrary base.

methods.name: pow
methods.description: Computes x raised to the power y, handling various special cases including negative bases and infinities, and using high-precision log/exp computations for non-integer exponents.

methods.name: pow
methods.description: Powers a double to an integer exponent efficiently using repeated multiplication and splitting techniques.
